description: This PHP file defines the class VTEntityDelta, which handles tracking changes (deltas) of entity records in the vtiger CRM system. It manages fetching entity data, detecting changes between old and new states, and providing access to change information.

classes.name: VTEntityDelta
classes.description: Handles change detection for CRM entity records, storing old and new states and computing differences.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for VTEntityDelta class, currently empty.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Main event handler that reacts to 'beforesave' and 'aftersave' events to track entity changes.

methods.name: fetchEntity
methods.description: Fetches current entity data from the database and stores it as the 'new' entity, also attaching comments for HelpDesk records.

methods.name: computeDelta
methods.description: Computes differences between old and new entity data, storing these as the delta.

methods.name: getEntityDelta
methods.description: Retrieves the computed change (delta) for a specific entity record, optionally forcing an update.

methods.name: getOldValue
methods.description: Returns the old value of a specific field for an entity record.

methods.name: getCurrentValue
methods.description: Returns the current value of a specific field for an entity record.

methods.name: getOldEntity
methods.description: Returns the entire old entity data object.

methods.name: getNewEntity
methods.description: Returns the entire new entity data object.

methods.name: hasChanged
methods.description: Checks if a specific field has changed between the old and new entity states.
